children: Arthur Hayes wrote on X that market conditions are difficult and investors should resist the urge to buy the dip, since judgments about whether the market has bottomed may be right or wrong. According to Odaily, Hayes said investors could buy with greater confidence, even at higher prices, once relief measures advanced by Kevin Warsh and Bessent are implemented.

title: Arthur Hayes: Curb Dip-Buying and Wait for U.S. Relief Measures Before Buying
